product.title: Award Winning UTV Slot Canyon Tour

description.text: Ride UTVs to Red Cave slot canyons on East Zion's award-winning two-hour slot canyon tour. Guides drive or lead you along off-road routes to upper and lower Red Cave narrows with time for photos in the red sandstone corridors. This compact outing delivers slot canyon access without a long hike or technical rappelling. Ideal for first-time visitors to East Zion seeking a high-review-count adventure.

highlights: Upper and Lower Red Cave narrows
Photo time in red sandstone slots

start.description: Meet at the Orderville staging area on US-89. Confirm exact meeting coordinates when booking.

end.description: Return to the Orderville staging area after the lower canyon stop.
